text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wah, amazing...!
It's full of foods I saw at the racetrack...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A lineup truly worthy of the name "Nationwide Racetrack Gourmet Fair"...
Where should I begin my assault...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's ramen from Kokura Racecourse, isn't it?
It's so good, the thin noodles coating the tonkotsu brothâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That's...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, on the day Nature-san won her first graded race
with a final 3-furlong time of 34.6 seconds,
she ate—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Oi's beef offal stew, huh? Now that's a stylish pick!
Once you get a taste of that salty flavor, you just can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That's the one rumored to be the mastermind
who secretly supported Inari's incredible
8-race winning streak...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There are two shrimp tempura in here...
Fufu, this is the kishimen from Chukyo Racecourse, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
They say that... with a gleam reminiscent of a golden shachihoko,
it brings back the sheer thrill of Suzuka-san's 10-length victory race—
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about racetrack food, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
They do say that behind the history of racing,
there is always gourmet food...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides... this fair is simply incredible.
Every single one of these famous gourmet dishes
supported a legendary race...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: As someone who loves racing history, I must pay my respects to this fair as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I will savor every single item on the menu...
and experience the entire history of racetrack gourmet...!
choice_data_list: Aren't you eating a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However, asking me to leave anything out
of such a wonderful lineup is simply...
choice_data_list: We still have time, so let's savor it in portions.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I was so worked up that even such a simple solution completely slipped my mind...
choice_data_list: You could say that's very Chrono-like, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I have no excuse.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Then let's come up with a plan and conquer
all the racetrack gourmet food during the event...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Let us be on our way, then...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the opportunity, taking racing history into account,
I believe proceeding in chronological order would be best...
choice_data_list: Could you give me an explanation like the one earlier?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, please leave it to me...!

Alongside a serious yet happy Chrono Genesis,
we enjoyed the racetrack gourmet to our hearts' content.
